description: Service d'attente en gare is a dataset listed in SNCF Open Data, an open data portal of a railway operator, published or maintained by SNCF. Ce jeu de données présente, pour chaque gare, les services suivants mis à disposition: Pianos en libre-service, Babyfoot, Distributeurs d'histoires courtes, Power & Station (vélos pour recharger son smartphone ou sa tablette), Playing Wall (jukebox digital). Coverage: France. The portal files it under Services gare. Its keywords are Services en gare, Loisirs, Gare de voyageurs. The portal shows 2026-09-28 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Data Commons Open Database License (ODbL) (https://data.sncf.com/pages/licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-sncf-open-data-portal.
